103void APlatformingCharacter::MultiJump()
104{
105 // ignore jumps while dashing
106 if(bIsDashing)
107 return;
108
109 // are we already in the air?
110 if (GetCharacterMovement()->IsFalling())
111 {
112
113 // have we already wall jumped?
114 if (!bHasWallJumped)
115 {
116 // run a sphere sweep to check if we're in front of a wall
117 FHitResult OutHit;
118
119 const FVector TraceStart = GetActorLocation();
120 const FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart + (GetActorForwardVector() * WallJumpTraceDistance);
121 const FCollisionShape TraceShape = FCollisionShape::MakeSphere(WallJumpTraceRadius);
122
123 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
124 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
125
126 if (GetWorld()->SweepSingleByChannel(OutHit, TraceStart, TraceEnd, FQuat(), ECollisionChannel::ECC_Visibility, TraceShape, QueryParams))
127 {
128 // rotate the character to face away from the wall, so we're correctly oriented for the next wall jump
129 FRotator WallOrientation = OutHit.ImpactNormal.ToOrientationRotator();
130 WallOrientation.Pitch = 0.0f;
131 WallOrientation.Roll = 0.0f;
132
133 SetActorRotation(WallOrientation);
134
135 // apply a launch impulse to the character to perform the actual wall jump
136 const FVector WallJumpImpulse = (OutHit.ImpactNormal * WallJumpBounceImpulse) + (FVector::UpVector * WallJumpVerticalImpulse);
137
138 LaunchCharacter(WallJumpImpulse, true, true);
139
140 // enable the jump trail
141 SetJumpTrailState(true);
142
143 // raise the wall jump flag to prevent an immediate second wall jump
144 bHasWallJumped = true;
145
146 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(WallJumpTimer, this, &APlatformingCharacter::ResetWallJump, DelayBetweenWallJumps, false);
147 }
148 // no wall jump, try a double jump next
149 else
150 {
151 // are we still within coyote time frames?
152 if (GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds() - LastFallTime < MaxCoyoteTime)
153 {
154 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Warning, TEXT("Coyote Jump"));
155
156 // use the built-in CMC functionality to do the jump
157 Jump();
158
159 // enable the jump trail
160 SetJumpTrailState(true);
161
162 // no coyote time jump
163 } else {
164
165 // only double jump once while we're in the air
166 if (!bHasDoubleJumped)
167 {
168 bHasDoubleJumped = true;
169
170 // use the built-in CMC functionality to do the double jump
171 Jump();
172
173 // enable the jump trail
174 SetJumpTrailState(true);
175 }
176
177 }
178
179
180 }
181 }
182
183 }
184 else
185 {
186 // we're grounded so just do a regular jump
187 Jump();
188
189 // activate the jump trail
190 SetJumpTrailState(true);
191 }
192}

200void APlatformingCharacter::DoMove(float Right, float Forward)
201{
202 if (GetController() != nullptr)
203 {
204 // momentarily disable movement inputs if we've just wall jumped
205 if (!bHasWallJumped)
206 {
207 // find out which way is forward
208 const FRotator Rotation = GetController()->GetControlRotation();
209 const FRotator YawRotation(0, Rotation.Yaw, 0);
210
211 // get forward vector
212 const FVector ForwardDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::X);
213
214 // get right vector
215 const FVector RightDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::Y);
216
217 // add movement
218 AddMovementInput(ForwardDirection, Forward);
219 AddMovementInput(RightDirection, Right);
220 }
221 }
222}

234void APlatformingCharacter::DoDash()
235{
236 // ignore the input if we've already dashed and have yet to reset
237 if (bHasDashed)
238 return;
239
240 // raise the dash flags
241 bIsDashing = true;
242 bHasDashed = true;
243
244 // disable gravity while dashing
245 GetCharacterMovement()->GravityScale = 0.0f;
246
247 // reset the character velocity so we don't carry momentum into the dash
248 GetCharacterMovement()->Velocity = FVector::ZeroVector;
249
250 // enable the jump trails
251 SetJumpTrailState(true);
252
253 // play the dash montage
254 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
255 {
256 const float MontageLength = AnimInstance->Montage_Play(DashMontage, 1.0f, EMontagePlayReturnType::MontageLength, 0.0f, true);
257
258 // has the montage played successfully?
259 if (MontageLength > 0.0f)
260 {
261 AnimInstance->Montage_SetEndDelegate(OnDashMontageEnded, DashMontage);
262 }
263 }
264}

287void APlatformingCharacter::EndDash()
288{
289 // restore gravity
290 GetCharacterMovement()->GravityScale = 2.5f;
291
292 // reset the dashing flag
293 bIsDashing = false;
294
295 // are we grounded after the dash?
296 if (GetCharacterMovement()->IsMovingOnGround())
297 {
298 // reset the dash usage flag, since we won't receive a landed event
299 bHasDashed = false;
300
301 // deactivate the jump trails
302 SetJumpTrailState(false);
303 }
304}

324void APlatformingCharacter::SetupPlayerInputComponent(UInputComponent* PlayerInputComponent)
325{
326 // Set up action bindings
327 if (UEnhancedInputComponent* EnhancedInputComponent = Cast<UEnhancedInputComponent>(PlayerInputComponent))
328 {
329
330 // Jumping
331 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(JumpAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, this, &APlatformingCharacter::DoJumpStart);
332 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(JumpAction, ETriggerEvent::Completed, this, &APlatformingCharacter::DoJumpEnd);
333
334 // Moving
335 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(MoveAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &APlatformingCharacter::Move);
336 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(MouseLookAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &APlatformingCharacter::Look);
337
338 // Looking
339 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(LookAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &APlatformingCharacter::Look);
340
341 // Dashing
342 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(DashAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &APlatformingCharacter::Dash);
343 }
344}

358void APlatformingCharacter::OnMovementModeChanged(EMovementMode PrevMovementMode, uint8 PreviousCustomMode /*= 0*/)
